description.en: Remembers the music that is playing: its name (CMND_SND_GET_ID_BGM) and position (CMND_SND_GET_POS_BGM) go into the globals history_bgm_name and history_bgm_pos, for OpenBgmHistory. No shipped script calls it.

examples.case: Keeping the music across a scene (not found in script_clean/; invented)
